body.name: Published raw no-carry-over capacity subclass
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_H^{\mathrm J}=\{\mathsf P\in\mathfrak M_H:\mathcal L_{\mathsf P}(Y_K^{1\to0}-Y_k^{1\to0}\mid S_k^1=1)=\mathcal L_{\mathsf P}(Z\mid S_k^0=1)\}\), where the equality is equality of probability laws on \(\mathbb Z_+\). Thus the subclass imposes the published uncapped residual no-carry-over equality in addition to, and not in place of, every restriction defining \(\mathfrak M_H\); in particular it retains \(B+W\le H\) almost surely among intensive survivors.
